questions.question:
D3 — Issue 1: How should the header actions establish that Save is the primary action?
Project/branch/task: branch main, Settings Page UI redesign, Pass 1 Information Architecture.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel, and Export look identical. A user scanning the header cannot tell which button does the thing they came for, and at 640px and below Save already sits alone on its own row while looking like a secondary control. DESIGN.md already decides this: Save is the only filled primary button, the other three are neutral ghost buttons. Principle: hierarchy as service; if everything shouts, nothing wins.
Stakes if we pick wrong: users hesitate or hit Reset/Cancel by mistake, and the confirmation dialog becomes a safety net for a hierarchy problem.
Recommendation: 1A because it applies the existing Button variants with zero new tokens and matches the approved design system exactly.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=6/10, 1C=3/10
Pros / cons:
1A) Save filled primary (#1d4ed8, white text); Reset, Cancel, Export as neutral ghost buttons (recommended) (human: ~1h / CC: ~5min)
  ✅ Exact DESIGN.md tokens via the existing Button component variants, nothing new to invent
  ✅ Primary reads first at every viewport, including the full-width Save row at 640px and below
  ❌ Touches the button variant props on all four actions, so a small visual regression check is needed
1B) Save filled primary; leave Reset, Cancel, Export exactly as they render today (human: ~30min / CC: ~3min)
  ✅ Smallest possible change, only the Save button's variant flips
  ✅ Still gives the header one obvious primary control for the 3-second scan
  ❌ Three secondary buttons stay in whatever inconsistent style they have now, so the group still does not match DESIGN.md
1C) Defer: keep all four identical for this update (human: 0 / CC: 0)
  ✅ No implementation work in this PR
  ✅ Avoids any styling change to the action group
  ❌ Ships a documented DESIGN.md violation and leaves the page with no visible primary action
Net: full alignment with the approved Button variants versus a partial or deferred fix that leaves the header ambiguous.

options.label: 1A Primary + ghost (recommended)
options.description: Save filled #1d4ed8/white; Reset, Cancel, Export neutral ghost. Exact DESIGN.md.

options.label: 1B Save primary only
options.description: Flip only Save to the primary variant; leave the other three untouched.

options.label: 1C Defer
options.description: Keep all four identical; record as an open DESIGN.md violation.
